purpose: The app's main navigation down the side of the screen: links to sections, collapsible groups and a compact rail mode.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark

props.name: items
props.description: Links ({ id, label, href, icon? }) and groups ({ type: 'group', id, label, icon?, items })

props.name: currentId
props.description: Id of the current page; its link gets aria-current and its group opens

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Rail mode: icons only, labels kept for assistive tech

whenToUse: For an app with several top-level sections
When the navigation should stay visible beside the content
whenNotToUse: For a few sections — use the AppHeader navigation
antiPatterns: More than one level of groups

anatomy: A bordered column of links (icon and label); groups are disclosure buttons with a chevron; the current link has the primary container and a 2px edge
sizes: Width `size-drawer-sm`; links `size-control-md` tall; rail width `size-control-lg` plus padding
states: Hover and press `color-state-layer`; current `color-container-primary` with `color-on-container-primary` and a `color-interactive-default` edge; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`
motion: Layer and chevron over `motion-duration-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: A navigation landmark of links, not a menu (WAI-ARIA navigation pattern)
The current page has aria-current page
Groups are disclosure buttons with aria-expanded
Rail mode keeps each link's text for assistive tech
